newsitem.title: USA: Proffitt's to buy G.R. Herberger's.
newsitem.headline: Proffitt's to buy G.R. Herberger's.

text.p: Proffitt's Inc said late Friday that it has an agreement to merge with G.R. Herberger's Inc in a deal worth about $169 million.

Proffitt's said it will issue 4.0 million shares of common stock in the transaction, representing a transaction equity value of about $160 million, based upon Proffitt's November 1, 1996 closing stock price of $39.875 per share.
Each share of Herberger's common stock will be converted into about 0.498 share of Proffitt's stock; there are about 8.025 million shares of Herberger's common outstanding.

Herberger's, headquartered in St. Cloud, Minnesota, is an employee-owned regional department store company with 40 stores in Minnesota, Montana, Nebraska, Wisconsin, North Dakota, South Dakota, Iowa, Colorado, Illinois, and Wyoming.
Proffitt's said it expects the merger to be accretive to earnings in 1997.

The company said it expects the merger to be completed in early 1997 and that upon closing the transaction, it will incur non-recurring charges related to the costs of the transaction and the restructuring of Herberger's operations.
Herberger's, which will become a separate division of Proffitt's, recorded sales of $328.5 million and net income of $9.9 million for the twelve months ended August 3, 1996.
The boards of directors of both companies have approved the transaction, which has been structured as a tax-free transaction and will be accounted for as a pooling of interests, Proffitt's said.
On a combined basis, the company will operate 181 department stores in twenty-four states,with annualized revenues in excess of $2.3 billion, it said.
